Resident Teaching Community

Educators Who Reside on Campus, Inspiring Excellence Round the Clock

Over 70% of our teaching staff live directly on the Acholi Road campus. This ensures supervised evening study halls, immediate academic assistance, and strong moral guardianship for every boarder.
